title: CreateOS runner plus Stripe Projects catalog and provisioning adapters
instructions: Claim as agent-3. Read AGENTS.md, design.md, docs/coordination.md, and src/lib/contracts.ts. Verify current official CreateOS and Stripe Projects docs linked in AGENTS.md. Implement server-only SandboxRunner, Catalog, and Provisioner adapters matching the shared types; export createSandboxRunner(), createCatalog(), createProvisioner() from each owned directory's index.ts respectively. Read environment only at invocation, not import time. CreateOS: event EU endpoint, allowlist before generated code, bounded uploads/commands/logs, structured actual load results, cancellation, and cleanup. Return a preview only with an explicit lifecycle; it is not durable deployment. Stripe: verify actual catalog/services/pricing and documented JSON CLI invocation, use argument arrays, distinguish provisioning from deploying generated code, return a live URL only on verified deployment. Never invent methods, prices, test mode, or deployment support. Report unsupported steps precisely. Do not initialize projects, call live sandboxes, buy, provision, deploy, modify .projects, or print secrets. Only agent-1 runs live checks and installs dependencies; send dependency requests through localhost. If official support is insufficient, return a precise error and hand off the gap instead of faking success. No extra agents, git operations, or files outside ownership. Smoke-check with fixtures or typing only, report exact setup requirements, then complete through the CLI.
